name: Ellie — still on the course, buying her first wing
summary: Mid-way through her training, 8 hours and about a dozen flights, still flying school gear. Launches regularly need several attempts. Needs to buy a wing soon and is wondering whether to skip the A and get a low-B.
why_this_persona: The commonest real-world version of this question, and a multi-gate case. The result must read as 'ask your instructor, this is their call' rather than as a verdict on her.

notes: The 'still_in_training' gate message must be shown first and must make clear that schools legitimately put students on low-B wings — the cap is a deferral to her instructor, not a judgement on her flying.
No ground-handling gate exists, by design (knowledge/disagreements.md point 11): her weak kiting shows up only in the score and in the suggestions. Her launch answer is what gates.
rules_expected is empty because gates short-circuit the threshold rules. Her skills score of about 35 would independently trip the Not yet floor if no gate had fired.
